'''House Dooku''' was a royal house of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], one of the six [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]] that ruled the planet. The Head of the family bore the title of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count Dooku of Serenno]].

== History ==

=== Fall of the Republic ===
[[File:Serenno-TCW.png|left|thumb|270x270px|[[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], House Dooku's homeworld.]]
During the last century of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Birth Years" /> House Dooku was one of the six [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]], the wealthiest and most powerful families of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]],<ref name="AOTE2" /> located in [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and site of its ancestral lands.<ref name=":2">{{SWE|locations|serenno|Serenno}}</ref> Itself one of the most powerful and wealthy families in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]],<ref name=":3">{{FactFile2014|34|DOO 1–4|Count Dooku}}</ref> it was protected by a [[House Dooku security team|security team]].<ref name="AOTE2" />

In [[102 BBY/Legends|102 BBY]] the House saw the birth of a [[Dooku/Legends|male member]],<ref name=":0">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> that in future would being known simply with his family name.<ref name="Film II"/> [[Dooku's father|His]] [[Dooku's mother|parents]] allowed him to be taken by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="Y:DR"/> as they had [[Dooku's brother/Legends|another son]] to continue the Dooku bloodline.<ref name="Agent of the Empire" /> Unlike most younglings, he was aware of his origins and felt driven to prove himself worthy of them.<ref name=":0" /> While Dooku was trained by the Jedi,<ref name="Film II" /> his brother took the title of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count of Serenno]] and was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a woman named [[Kostanza Dooku|Kostanza]], with whom he had a child, [[Adan Dooku]]. However, during his son's childhood the count died, leaving his son to take his place as the new count. Because of Adan's youth, his mother acted as regent.<ref name="Agent of the Empire" />
[[File:Dooku TCW.jpg|thumb|405x405px|Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the member of the House who had most influence in galactic history.]]
Meanwhile in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name=":1">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Dooku, as a consequence of the death of his former apprentice [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and due to his growing disenchantment with the Jedi way, left the Jedi Order.<ref name="Film II" /> Shortly thereafter, he met with [[Supreme Chancellor|Sumpreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and informed him that he intended to claim his hereditary title of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] of Serenno and that he sought a potential alliance with the Sith, as he believed that they shared his aim to reforge the galaxy.<ref>[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> He became secretly [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]' next Sith apprentice, Darth Tyranus.<ref name="Film II" /> With his arrival back to [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] and claiming his family title of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]]<ref name=":4">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> that was his birthrigth,<ref name=":3" /> Adan and Kostanza left the planet in self-[[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Agent of the Empire" /> He became the master of his family fortune and one of the wealthiest men in the galaxy.<ref name=":4" /> He moved his base of operations to a cliff-side [[Dooku's palace/Legends|palace]] with a commanding view of the lush [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of his homeworld.<ref name=":2" />

As plans laid by the Sith for over a decade began to come to fruition, Dooku reappeared on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]],<ref name="Databank: Raxus Prime">{{DB|location|raxusprime|Raxus Prime}}</ref> commandeering a Republic communications station in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]]<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and giving a speech that heavily criticized the Republic for its decadence, hypocrisy, and corruption and the Jedi Order for its complacency. Dooku publicly called for entire systems to secede from the Republic and join the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist movement]].<ref name="Dooku Spotted in Gree Enclave">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 54|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #54]]</ref> When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out<ref name="Film II" /> [[22 BBY/Legends|two years later]],<ref name=":1" /> Dooku led the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Film II" /> for the following [[19 BBY/Legends|three years]],<ref name=":1" /> as the Great Houses of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] supported him and the Separatists.<ref name="AOTE2" /> During the war he continued to operated from his [[Dooku's palace/Legends|palace]] on the planet.<ref name="Night"/> As Serenno was now in line with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Adan remained on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] through the war, becoming friends with [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]].<ref name="Agent of the Empire" /> Dooku's revelance continued until he was killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] aboard the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref>{{Film|III}}</ref>

During the final stages of the Clone Wars, Adan returned to Serenno to claim the vacant title of Count, much to the disdain of the other Serenno houses, who saw no value in a Count that was raised on another planet.<ref name="Agent of the Empire" />

=== Imperial Era ===
After the end of Clone Wars, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was sent to Serenno by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to enact the retaliation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the six ruling Houses. Vader had previously discussed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] role with Serenno, but had not told the young Count of his true intentions. Vader declared that since all of the other great houses had allied themselves with the deceased Dooku, they must [[Cleansing of Serenno|purge]] the traitors in their midst by executing the current heads of every house. Dooku vehemently protested, but could do nothing as Vader revealed the final part of the deal—the sons must kill their own fathers, in order to ascend, and if anyone resisted, all of them would be killed. As Dooku watched in horror, the sons massacrated the assembled nobles. He was spared as he was in exile during the Clone Wars.<ref name="AOTE2" />
[[File:Assassinationofadandooku.jpg|left|thumb|270x270px|[[Adan Dooku]] is killed in front of his son [[Bron Dooku|Bron]].]]
In time, Adan Dooku had a son<ref name="Agent of the Empire" /> around [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]] <ref>[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 1]] is set around three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''. ''Hard Targets'' 1 states that Bron was ten years old during the events of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]], dating his [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] to around [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]].</ref> named [[Bron Dooku]], with his wife, [[Maite Dooku|Maite]].<ref name="Agent of the Empire" /> During his father's reign, Bron regularly travelled with Adan aboard the Dooku airship ''[[Windrunner/Legends|Windrunner]]''. As part of his training to become the next [[Count/Legends|Count]], he was taught by his father about [[Politics/Legends|politics]], and how to look at situations realistically and pragmatically.<ref name="AOTE2" /> Eventually, Dooku was branded as a target for [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] by an individual within the Imperial hierarchy, in cooperation with [[Rodas Borgin|Borgin]] of [[House Borgin]]. Imperial agent [[Jahan Cross]] was sent to complete the job.<ref name="Agent of the Empire" /> Around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]],<ref>The date of this story is established internally in relation to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the Dookus attended the [[25th anniversary of the settling of the Alderaan Ascendancy Contention|twenty-fifth anniversary]] of the [[Alderaan Ascendancy Contention]] in [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]]. Organa found some time to speak to Adan in solitude, attempting to persuade the Count to join the growing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|insurrection against the Galactic Empire]]. Organa believed the Count had great influence, despite the second guesses of the Count himself due to his upbringing on Alderaan and the conflict his origins had caused with the other Houses of Serenno. Cross, donning a fake suit of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] created by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] to impersonate [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], took aim at the Count through one of the room's windows. The shot hit Dooku directly in the heart and breached the room's window. Dooku's young son, Bron, witnessed the murder.<ref name="Agent of the Empire" />

Bron went with the other House Lords aboard the [[Windrunner/Legends|''Windrunner'']] to decide his fate. He then met [[Jahan Cross]], whom he knew as Ambassador Cross's son. Bron was then kidnapped by [[Aveca Dunn]] during the ''[[Bloodskull]]''<nowiki/>'s attack,<ref name="AOTE2" /> and was rescued by Cross.<ref>[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 3|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 3]]</ref> Bron was taken to [[Otoh Dooku]], where Borgin's security chief [[Hovus Jorrick]] and his guard watched over him until Cross and [[Candra Tymon]] took him. He was pursued by Jorrick's guard<ref>[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 4|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 4]]</ref> and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], until Fett fired a missile at his shuttle, appearing to kill Bron. In reality, though, Bron had been taken to Alderaan to be raised by Bail Organa until he took his title and position as Serenno's regent if he wanted to.<ref>[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 5|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 5]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The house first appeared in the form of [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] in the novel ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' released in [[2002]].<ref name="The Approaching Storm">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref> It was first identified as House Dooku in [[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 2|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 2]], the seventh issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire]]'' series of comics<ref name="AOTE2"/> released on [[November 21]], [[2012]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54006/star_wars_agent_of_the_empire_-_hard_targets_2012_2|text=Star Wars: Agent Of The Empire - Hard Targets (2012) #2}}</ref> In the comic series "Dooku" is used as the family name,<ref name="Agent of the Empire" /> as several members are named Dooku as their last names.<ref name="Agent of the Empire" /><ref name="AOTE2" />

In the new [[Canon]] the house is named [[House Serenno]]<ref>''[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]''</ref> and the name "[[Dooku]]" does not qualify as the character's first nor last name, with it instead being a singular name. In this version Serennian aristocracy only use a singular name while being formally addressed as members of House Serenno. Therefore, Dooku's full name is not "Dooku Serenno," but the count would answer to the formal title "Dooku of House Serenno".<ref name="Cavan Scott Dooku name tweet 12">{{Twitter|cavanscott|status/1201761122522677248|[[Cavan Scott]]|quote=Don't think of it as a first name, but a singular name. The aristocracy of Serenno only use one name, but use the format Dooku of House Serenno, not Dooku Serenno. In my mind it started as a sign of the importance of independence which runs through Serenno culture.|archivedate=20191203071403}}</ref>
